scope: Bounded M0 actual-source inspection for approved v0.6 Track A/B; not a deployment, model benchmark, rights/clinical approval or personal-data execution.

observed.nodeAuthority: Existing Node owns active-account/source/capability/consent and private service target/token boundaries; new goals context never calls Python.
observed.pythonService: FastAPI private service middleware enforces configured token on /api/ml; raw-file upload disabled before multipart parsing. Analyze preserves supplied quantitative composition and withholds metabolites/health impacts/cohort comparisons/recommendations.
observed.legacyPrototype: Legacy metabolite formula and uncalibrated confidence/optimal ranges/pathway hypotheses remain prototype code, not verified concentration/strain genes. Randomized demo generator exists but is not an accepted missing-data substitute on the current service path.
observed.modelStatus: No pinned MICOM/model reconstruction/solver-backed validated community flux model or licensed substrate-conversion dataset is supplied by the inspected path. Cohort sample counts in old architecture prose are not measured study evidence.
observed.researchAdapter: Existing scenario/readiness/external adapter is distinct from legacy ML; disconnected or incomplete prerequisites yield blockers/no numbers. It is not evidence of a deployed model.
observed.executionGate: Actual /api/precision/metabolite-research handler requires restricted bloom.microbiome.flux capability before its owned-source/consent/external adapter. Existing policy/effective execution remains default-denied without independently installed trusted approvals; normal experimental UI cannot grant it.
